title: The Black Jew Wealth Coach - Research Results
description: Structured current-market SEO, search-intent, competitor, and content-opportunity research for The Black Jew Wealth Coach and Brandon Gardner.

primary_keyword.description: Primary SEO keyword selected or confirmed for the requested content topic.

secondary_keywords.description: Relevant secondary keywords, long-tail terms, and semantic variations separated by semicolons.

search_intent.description: Dominant search intent for the topic.

search_demand_summary.description: Concise explanation of what searchers appear to want to learn, compare, solve, find, or accomplish based on current research.

people_also_ask.description: Relevant search questions or common user questions separated by semicolons.

related_searches.description: Relevant related searches, semantic variations, and long-tail topic opportunities separated by semicolons.

competitor_urls.description: Specific competitor or competing content URLs actually identified during current research. Separate multiple URLs with semicolons.

competitor_strengths.description: Evidence-based summary of what current competing content does well.

competitor_gaps.description: Evidence-based summary of meaningful content gaps, weaknesses, or missed opportunities in current competing content.

unique_content_angle.description: Recommended differentiated content angle for The Black Jew Wealth Coach based on audience needs, competitor gaps, search intent, and business goals.

recommended_title.description: SEO-focused working title aligned with the primary keyword, current research, search intent, and brand positioning.

recommended_outline.description: Substantive H2/H3 article outline capable of supporting a detailed publication-ready article.

opportunity_score.description: Editorial content-opportunity score from 1 to 100 based on brand relevance, audience usefulness, search intent, business fit, competitive gap, attainable SEO opportunity when known, conversion potential, and content differentiation.

ai_recommendation.description: Strategic recommendation for how the later article-writing step should approach the topic, including emphasis, positioning, factual cautions, and conversion direction.

research_sources.description: Specific authoritative URLs actually accessed during current research. Separate multiple URLs with semicolons. Do not invent URLs.
